name: pmg-cost-the-delay
description: Builds a cost of delay sheet for contested, time-sensitive requests, with an urgency profile per item, a CD3 order, "yes, if" options that show what drops, and a reply to the person asking. Use for "run pmg-cost-the-delay", "everything is urgent", "cost of delay", "CD3", "how do I say no to my boss", "yes, if trade-off", "what drops if we take this on", "this cannot wait", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
